claims.title: Exact point-to-host and host-to-point degree-loss transport
claims.statement: Pt.From and Val identify the actual arithmetic bases, candidates and Frobenius steps. CanonInst supplies the canonical orbit selector, independently of Extra.kapI_def, which identifies the universal infima. Thus WeightVectorExists transfers to a zero-extended host pair with exact WinOK and WOK; conversely a point constructed From that pair satisfies actual WReq and WallPt.
assumptions: Supplied actual Pt C, Std C, Val C cD ch, Pt.From the indicated host, CanonInst, and its actual Extra.kapI_def.
For the forward existence application use GW5 at the point; for the reverse implication use host WOK and degrees zero off the selected set.

claims.title: Temporary-family selection and actual fixed-pair reconstruction for every position
claims.statement: Build a temporary family from supplied arbitrary-pair point constructors and numerical records, apply GW5 uniformly, and transfer the chosen pair to its original host. Invoke the universal point constructor again for this same pair and all u0<n. Prove every Pt.Same field, including the lifted offsets from fills and Val.hc, canonical kappaI, the whole natural-input ep function, code labels and cover; all resulting points satisfy WallPt.
assumptions: Literal HostExQW/HostGood with RankVal, canonical q0 and any additional retained host predicate.
Std C and C.GK.Nonneg; the actual ObjC/ObjCP point constructor for every admissible pair and all u0, with its uniform nested thresholds.
Supplied initial window pair, admissible injective code, and actual NumAt records for temporary and final points.
The temporary family meets the already stated GI/GII/GJ/GW5 hypotheses; its constants and J are fixed before the scale.
